title: [MAIN]-FIX-Bug 652365
summary: Fixed production order refresh failing when a component base quantity is smaller than its rounding precision by preserving the unrounded value in this specific case.
key_points: Refreshing production orders now handles components with base quantities smaller than rounding precision
Solution preserves unrounded values when premature rounding would reduce a nonzero quantity to zero
Standard rounding behavior is maintained in other scenarios
Test coverage added for the new behavior
quote: Refreshing a production order fails when a valid component base quantity is smaller than its rounding precision.
